content.title: We added a temporary credit of 40.00 while we review your dispute

body.text: Brindle Card added a temporary credit of 40.00 for your dispute dsp-0009 about the charge of 60.00 from Ironworks Gym on 2 November. The credit is not final. If the merchant refunds you, or the review ends in the merchant's favor, we will take the temporary credit back. Your dispute is still open.
